# A frost shard: a pale-blue ice spindle 0.14 x 0.34 m pointing -Y, origin at its centre. make_env.py.
new
material new Ice --base-color 0.4863 0.6314 0.7529 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name A --vertices 4 --radius1 0.08 --radius2 0 --depth 0.2 --location 0 -0.1 0 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Ice
add mesh cone --name B --vertices 4 --radius1 0.08 --radius2 0 --depth 0.14 --location 0 0.07 0 --rotation -90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Ice
select all
shade flat
export shard.glb
